name: 결과만 전달된 인수인계
prompt: Create a wide 16:9 editorial illustration for an internal company newsletter. Use clean flat vector shapes, thin navy outlines, subtle paper texture, an off-white background, and muted teal with coral accents. Show a slightly elevated cutaway view of two adjacent office desks. On the left, an employee wearing teal privately operates an automated workflow: their laptop screen visibly connects several document thumbnails through small processing gears into one finished report. A desk divider hides this screen and workflow from the colleague on the right, while keeping them visible to the viewer. The employee passes only the finished report across the divider. The colleague, wearing navy, reviews it beside an open manual whose pictures show a different, manual process of moving individual blocks between computer windows. Make the visual relationship unmistakable: the report crosses the divider, but knowledge of how it was produced does not. Both people look thoughtful and ordinary, without villainous or foolish expressions. Keep the composition simple and readable. All screen and document contents must use abstract geometric blocks only. No text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, or watermarks anywhere.

name: 함께 비교하고 이어받는 자동화
prompt: Create a wide 16:9 editorial illustration matching this exact visual style: clean flat vector shapes, thin navy outlines, subtle paper texture, an off-white background, and muted teal with coral accents. Reuse two office colleagues, one wearing teal and one wearing navy. Seat them together at an open shared desk, facing the same workspace. Make two large reports placed side by side the visual focal point. Both reports contain the same simple arrangement of geometric blocks, except that the report on the right has an empty position where a coral square appears in the report on the left. An open illustrated manual beside the left report establishes it as the result of the existing procedure. A laptop beside the right report shows document thumbnails connected through processing gears, establishing it as the automated result. The navy-clad colleague points directly to the discrepancy while the teal-clad colleague adjusts the laptop workflow. A third teammate watches the comparison with a clear view of the screen and an open shared workflow guide made entirely of connected pictograms. Convey collaborative verification and a method that the next person can understand and inherit. Keep expressions constructive and the workspace uncluttered. No text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, or watermarks anywhere.
